class.name: JRPGTileFlags
class.brief_description: Editor helpers that author JRPG tile flags on a TileSet and bake them into a JRPG tileset.
class.description: Tile flags (passage, four-direction passage, overhead, ladder, bush, counter, damage floor and terrain tag) are authored as custom data layers of the Godot [TileSet] named [code]jrpg_pass[/code], [code]jrpg_no_entry[/code], [code]jrpg_no_exit[/code], [code]jrpg_overhead[/code], [code]jrpg_ladder[/code], [code]jrpg_bush[/code], [code]jrpg_counter[/code], [code]jrpg_damage[/code] and [code]jrpg_terrain_tag[/code], so the TileSet editor can paint them as well. The database tools then bake them into [member JRPGTilesetData.flags], one word per palette index in the [method JRPGTilesetData.pack_flags] layout, so game code and servers read the flags without loading a TileSet. A bake records the hash of what it was made from in [member JRPGTilesetData.flags_hash]. When a tile flag or the palette changes, the bake is stale ([method is_stale]); saving the database bakes every stale tileset again.

method.name: ensure_layers
method.description: Adds the [code]jrpg_*[/code] custom data layers that [param tileset] does not have yet and returns how many were added.

method.name: get_entry_flags
method.description: Returns the flag word of a palette [param entry] (a dictionary of [member JRPGTilesetData.palette]), read from its first tile, or [code]0[/code] when the tile does not exist.

method.name: is_stale
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [member JRPGTilesetData.flags] of [param data] no longer matches the tile flags of [param tileset] or the palette of [param data].

method.name: rebake
method.description: Bakes the flags of [param data] again from [param tileset] when they are stale. Returns [code]true[/code] when [param data] changed.

method.name: set_entry_flags
method.description: Writes the flag word [param flags] to every tile a palette [param entry] stands for: one tile for a plain entry, every shape of an autotile or wall entry. Adds the custom data layers when they are missing. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when none of the entry's tiles exists.
